issues.quote: Herrgott, the regulator on the wall had stopped.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about the atelier regulator or its state.
issues.misreading: In a clock puzzle, a stopped regulator can be read as marking a time, such as when the victim died or when the clocks were tampered with. The sheet gives no such time, so a solver could invent a timing anchor that the fact sheet does not support.
